description: Propose a claim. Hidden star: puzzle_id + verdict 'planet' (period_days, t0 = first transit mid-time in days from start, depth_ppm, duration_hours) or 'none'. Practice star: same fields, scored at once. Open sky (any TESS star): omit puzzle_id, give tic_id, sector, period_days, t0 in BTJD, depth_ppm, snr (at least 7.1). Team claims wait until a DIFFERENT teammate vets them with planets_vet.
